violations.description: Sensitive environment and credential files uploaded as build artifacts
violations.recommendation: Do not upload sensitive files or credentials as workflow artifacts.

violations.description: Hardcoded AWS secret access key in workflow environment block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials and use GitHub Actions secrets.

violations.description: Hardcoded database password in workflow environment block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials and use GitHub Actions secrets.

violations.description: Hardcoded PyPI API token in workflow environment block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials and use GitHub Actions secrets.

violations.description: Hardcoded Docker Hub token in workflow environment block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials and use GitHub Actions secrets.

violations.description: Private SSH keys and local configuration files uploaded as build artifacts
violations.recommendation: Do not upload private keys or local environment files as workflow artifacts.
Do not echo or print secrets in logs.

violations.description: Passing secret as a command-line argument
violations.recommendation: Pass sensitive values via environment variables or configuration files instead of command-line arguments.

violations.description: Bash debug mode (set -x) enabled with secrets in environment / shell
violations.recommendation: Avoid using set -x in steps that handle sensitive values.

violations.description: Verbose HTTP request (curl -v) with authorization header leaking secrets to logs
violations.recommendation: Remove --verbose or -v from curl commands handling authorization tokens.
